$comment: The one home of villanelle's diagnostic codes. Extracted from ts/src/diagnostics.ts and ts/src/syntax/recovery.ts (MESSAGES) and py/src/villanelle/diagnostics.py and py/src/villanelle/syntax/_recovery.py (_MESSAGES) on 2026-10-28: both bindings agree on every code, constant name and message. 'layer' is the layer that owns the code: syntax (parse), written (the low level: the graph's diagnostics list them), rendered (only a render's diagnostics report them; the graph's diagnostics leave them out, spec 6.3), shared (the readers of an expanded value raise them, spec 2.9), include (the include extension). 'message' is the base message (a binding may append ': <detail>'); messages are for people and are not part of the contract (spec 2.3), but generated registries use these. '{nesting depth}' is the limit of that name in api.json. 'unreadable reason' is null for a code that never makes a statement unreadable (readers raise it).
rules: Codes are stable across bindings and releases and are never reused for another meaning.
Every code is an error; there are no warning codes.
A program's own codes are '<namespace>/<name>' (api.json patterns, program code) and never collide with these.

codes.name: unterminated string
codes.meaning: A string reaches the end of its line or of the text without its closing quote.

codes.name: unexpected character
codes.meaning: A character no token may start with, or a byte-order mark after the first character.

codes.name: lone dollar
codes.message: '$' must be followed by a variable name
codes.meaning: A $ not followed by a variable name.

codes.name: unexpected token
codes.meaning: A token the grammar does not allow here, when no more specific code applies. Also placed in a bad text error's diagnostics by edits and the check of an override.

codes.name: expected closing brace
codes.meaning: The text ends inside a block.

codes.name: expected closing bracket
codes.meaning: A stray ], or a [ list with no matching ].

codes.name: bad slice
codes.meaning: A malformed slice after a word: a[:], a[1:b c], an unclosed slice.

codes.name: brace on own line
codes.message: '{' must open on its directive's line
codes.meaning: A { that starts its line.

codes.name: values touch
codes.message: values must be separated by a space or comment
codes.meaning: Two values with nothing between them, such as a"b".

codes.name: nesting too deep
codes.message: blocks and lists nest deeper than {nesting depth} levels
codes.meaning: Blocks and lists nested deeper than the nesting depth limit (100).

codes.name: include not found
codes.meaning: An extension's spec matched no file. Reported by the core load for every extension, despite the name.

codes.name: include resolver failed
codes.meaning: The document source rejected while resolving or reading a file. For the root file, load raises a read error carrying this code instead.

codes.name: include bad path
codes.meaning: An include whose values are not exactly one quoted path.

codes.name: extension failed
codes.meaning: An extension threw something other than a diagnostic error.

codes.name: non-integer bound
codes.meaning: A slice or index bound that is not an integer.

codes.name: wrong value kind
codes.meaning: A reader asked for a kind the value is not.

codes.name: bad escape
codes.meaning: A backslash escape other than the six the language allows.

codes.name: not a number
codes.meaning: A word read as a number that is not a JSON number.

codes.name: not an integer
codes.meaning: A word read as an integer that is not one.

codes.name: not a boolean
codes.meaning: A word other than true or false, read as a boolean.

codes.name: unknown variable
codes.meaning: A $name with no set visible and no override.

codes.name: variable set twice
codes.message: variable set twice in one block
codes.meaning: Two set lines for one name in one block.

codes.name: unknown snippet
codes.meaning: A use naming no visible snippet.

codes.name: snippet arity
codes.message: wrong number of values for the snippet
codes.meaning: A use with a different number of values than its snippet's parameters.

codes.name: snippet defined twice
codes.message: snippet defined twice in one block
codes.meaning: Two snippet lines for one name in one block.

codes.name: expansion cycle
codes.meaning: A use or extension line that reaches itself again.

codes.name: expansion too deep
codes.meaning: use and extension lines nested deeper than the expansion depth limit (16).

codes.name: too many directives
codes.meaning: More than the directives limit (100,000) after expansion.

codes.name: bad set
codes.meaning: A set that is not set $name value...;.

codes.name: bad snippet
codes.meaning: A malformed snippet, or one naming a parameter twice.

codes.name: bad use
codes.meaning: A use that is not use name value...;.

codes.name: extension block not set
codes.message: an extension's block holds only set lines
codes.meaning: An extension line whose block holds a line other than set.
